capture.method: Extract the exact public commit into a temporary directory. In the named harness, after cookie sign-in, POST /api/v1/auth/tokens with name Read-only catalogue fixture and the listed scopes; replace the client with a cookie-free http.Client whose RoundTripper sets Authorization: Bearer from the issued token. Write the unchanged GET /api/v1/app/resources response body immediately before its existing JSON unmarshal with os.WriteFile(os.Getenv("MOBILE_CATALOG_CAPTURE"), []byte(body), 0600). Retain all original assertions. Run the recorded test with that output path and isolated PLATFORMKIT_TEST_ADMIN_URL / PLATFORMKIT_TEST_DATABASE_URL. Copy only the catalogue response after the test succeeds; never record the issued credential.
capture.scope: The public reference composition at this commit as a read-only scoped key, not every actor or server. No person portrait field is adopted in this capture.
